name: csx-method-fqn-suffix-match
body: The mixed .cs/.csx scan test only checks that a declaration whose name ends in `Twice` is emitted, because no expected parent scope is defined for script top-level methods; it does not assert the .csx File record's parent or any .csx edges. Upgrade: pin the exact script-method FQN once its parent form is agreed (phase 8's .csx fixture is the natural place).
